arguments.command:
cd /app/work && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, random, subprocess, sys
PROG="/app/submission/scheduler.py"
rng=random.Random(31337)
viol=0; checks=0
for it in range(200):
    Q=rng.randint(1,6); L=rng.randint(1,4)
    U=rng.choice([1,2,3,8,32])
    R=rng.randint(1,min(4,U))
    cuts=sorted(rng.sample(range(1,U),R-1)) if R>1 else []
    borders=[0]+cuts+[U]
    n=rng.randint(1,80)
    style=rng.choice(['same','spread','skew'])
    packets=[]
    for i in range(n):
        if style=='same': r=rng.randrange(U)
        elif style=='spread': r=rng.randrange(U)
        else: r=rng.choice([0, U-1])
        packets.append({"id":"w%d"%i,"lane":rng.randrange(L),"rank":r})
    obj={"mode":"burst","banks":Q,"lanes":L,"limit":U,"borders":borders,
         "start_bank":rng.randrange(Q),"packets":packets}
    proc=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',PROG],input=json.dumps(obj).encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
    out=json.loads(proc.stdout)
    for r,rep in enumerate(out["ranges"]):
        checks+=1
        if rep["observed"]>rep["bound"]:
            viol+=1
            print("VIOL", r, rep, obj["banks"], obj["lanes"], borders, style)
print("checks",checks,"violations",viol)
EOF
